characters.name: Prinsen
characters.description: A young and regal figure with a lean but strong build, standing at a moderate height. His facial features are sharp with high cheekbones and a troubled expression due to his ordeal. He has medium-length, unruly sandy hair blowing wildly in the powerful north wind. Dressed in a ceremonial outfit with intricate designs, befitting royalty, he is in distress as he is grabbed by the king near the castle's edge amidst a turbulent scene.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: A stern and authoritative man of average height and stout build, the king has a commanding presence. His facial features include a furrowed brow, deep-set eyes, and a resolute expression. He is dressed in royal attire with a heavy cloak and a crown, exuding power and control. The setting is dramatic, with the north wind howling as he forcefully grabs the prince by the neck at the castle.

characters.name: Konen_med_koen
characters.description: A robust, middle-aged woman of medium height with a sturdy build, she has a practical demeanor. Her hair is tied back in a simple bun, and her expression is focused and slightly anxious as she leads a cow and carries a chicken. She is dressed in worn rural attire—a long, weathered dress, apron, and boots—appropriate for a journey to sell the animals.

characters.name: Konen_med_fjær
characters.description: A perplexed woman, average in stature, with a mildly rounded build, now covered in feathers from head to toe due to a prank. She has bewildered eyes and a wide-open mouth expressing confusion, as she questions her identity. Her attire is hidden beneath the feathers, making her look like a bizarre creature.

characters.name: Mannen_med_birken
characters.description: A clever and cheeky man, slightly taller than average, with an athletic build. He has mischievous eyes and a playful grin, his expression one of amusement as he scams someone with a cunning trick. His casual clothing is suited for outdoor activities, and he is actively tying horsehair to a birch tree amidst a forest setting.

characters.name: Konen_med_salt
characters.description: This woman of a somewhat stout build is obviously frazzled and confused, standing in a field, sowing salt with intense concentration. Her hair is loosely covered by a kerchief. She is wearing a simple dress, apron, and boots, indicating her rural life. Her expression vacillates between determination and confusion as she tends to the barren land.

characters.name: Skytteren
characters.description: A rugged male hunter, tall and lean, with a face showing years of outdoor wisdom. He is wearing traditional hunting gear: a sturdy coat, boots, and a wide-brimmed hat. His expression is one of surprise and empathy as he encounters the snipe. He carries a rifle and looks around the lush forest setting with seasoned eyes.

characters.name: Myrsnipe_mor
characters.description: A petite snipe mother with a delicate body, feathers fluffed with worry. Her small, dark eyes hold a pleading, fretful expression as she communicates her distress. Positioned close to the ground near a forest clearing, she appears to be protecting an unseen brood of chicks.
